portInfo.description: Carnival operates the Long Beach Cruise Terminal at 231 Windsor Way beside the Queen Mary — a separate embarkation point from Port of Los Angeles San Pedro. Confirm US LGB vs US LAX on cruise documents and rideshare apps before you travel.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Aquarium of the Pacific — Shoreline Drive — ~150 min.
Shoreline Village / Rainbow Harbor — walk or short rideshare — ~90 min.
Queen Mary historic ship — adjacent to terminal — ~120 min.
Pine Avenue dining district — short transfer — ~90 min.
Downtown Long Beach waterfront — flexible short call.
thingsToDo.shortCall: ≥4 h. Aquarium or Shoreline Village loop with ≥75 min buffer — terminal parking garage height limits apply (check Carnival/Visit Long Beach pages).
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Double-check US LGB vs US LAX on your documents — rideshare to the wrong harbour wastes an embark morning.

gettingThere.fromTerminal: Long Beach Cruise Terminal — 231 Windsor Way, Long Beach, CA 90802
gettingThere.publicTransport: Airports. Visit Long Beach publishes driving guidance from LAX and Long Beach Airport (LGB) on its cruise terminal pages — check those pages before sailing. Downtown. Pine Avenue and Shoreline Village are typically a short taxi or rideshare from Windsor Way; allow buffer on turnaround mornings.
